question: Which of the following is soda lime?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NaOH + CaO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Soda-lime is a mixture of Sodium hydroxide(NaOH) and Calcium oxide(CaO).
 
• The Chemical formula of the soda lime is CaHNaO2.
 
• The main components present in soda-lime are Calcium hydroxide(about 75%), Water(about 20%), Sodium hydroxide(about 3%), and Potassium hydroxide (about 1%).
 
• It is mainly used to absorb moisture and gases.
 
• Soda-lime is used in gas masks as an absorbent for toxic gases.
 
• Soda-lime causes severe damage to the gastrointestinal tract.
